text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. And yet, for 
some reason—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And now, El El vs. Trainer-san! It's time 
for a game of tag, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
First, Trainer's the tagger, and El runs 
away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The game of tag began.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, can you catch me before time runs 
out!? If you catch me, El's special 
homemade chocolate is yours as a prize!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If we fail, it's bean dishes for dinner, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why do we get chocolates if we're caught, 
but bean dishes if we fail? Harboring all 
sorts of questions, I ended up playing a 
game of tag.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... How is it, Trainer-san!? Are 
you ready to give up?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, that's some admirable grit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's stamina is truly on a whole 
different level. Exhausted, I reached out 
my hand with my consciousness fading—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wha-wha-what-desu?! Where are you 
trying to grab-desu?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fingertips snagged on El Condor Pasa's 
mask, and then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She actually won it. El Condor Pasa's face 
was turning an unusually bright shade of 
red...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't look. Taking off my mask is 
against the rules, desu...
choice_data_list: Why are you blushing so much?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, that's... I-It was just... 
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I've never... given someone chocolates 
before, so... I figured if you caught me 
and took them... it'd feel more natural.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Natural...? It seems challenging me to a 
game of tag was just El Condor Pasa's way 
of hiding her embarrassment."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just the edge of the mask, 
a touch is out... It's El's... defeat, 
desu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please have this chocolate. It 
is... handmade...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received a sweet, homemade gift. When I 
opened it right away and took a bite—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Trainer! Are you okay? Are you still 
alive!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I might have put in way too many 
jalapeños, deesu!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This might just be a masterpiece in its 
own right. It's been a stimulating 
Valentine's in more ways than one."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This might just be a masterpiece in its 
own right. It's been a stimulating 
Valentine's in more ways than one."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And afterwards—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, next up is our Valentine's date, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Let's stroll through the parks and the 
city at night, guided purely by passion!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There isn't much atmosphere, but perhaps a 
stroll wouldn't hurt. And—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everything in order? Just because 
it's Valentine's, there's no telling who 
might get carried away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Catch every single person trying to go 
outside. Don't let even one of them get 
out.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! Student Council Vice President 
Air Groove-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
She is a formidable foe, yes... Once she 
catches you, she won't let go, just like a 
viper! All that awaits is to be squeezed 
tighter and tighter!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Is this the end for us?! Is this as far as 
we go?! Do we have no choice but to give 
up on our Valentine's date?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, even with a 
Trainer accompanying you, going out at 
night without permission was strictly 
forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Strict as Air Groove is, I doubt she'll 
let this slide. In that case――

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, you mean that thing from earlier!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai, Happy Valentine's♪ TO 
YOOOU!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here's a gift of highly nutritious 
chocolate for our exhausted senior!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? El Condor Pasa, is it? My apologies, 
I'll help myself then...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
GWWAAAHHH!!!!! Wh-What is with this 
spice?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You bastard, you poisoned me, didn't you!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"No problem at all! That spiciness will 
get ya hooked!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
N-Now, Trainer-san, let's make our getaway 
while we still caaaan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Bueno~! That was so 
much fun, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Did your heart pound too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, getting through a crisis together 
makes me feel kind of special...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've become super friendly. 
Uh, let's see, if I remember correctly, 
this effect...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The suspension bridge effect." 
Experiencing the same fear supposedly 
makes you feel closer to someone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's the suspended ceiling effect, 
desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"If my heart flutters a whole lot more, 
maybe Trainer and I can become super 
close!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Today, with El... will you do lots of 
Romero Specials with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's night. Amidst an 
uncharacteristically sweet atmosphere...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In my mind, I was constantly getting 
locked in a Romero Special by El Condor 
Pasa."
